thread:
Priya Rao: Quick alert 3 - Canary runs for quant-v2 on runtime-3.2 (eu) are showing steady growth in resident set size over longseq. Started ~2h ago.
Diego Martinez: Can you share the metric?
Priya Rao: Chart: mem_rss per session climbs from 6GB -> 20GB over 30m during a 1.1M token session. Link: https://redwood.monitoring/canary/qtv2-eu/rs
Lena Kim: Seen OOM on node-12 twice. Stack shows kv_cache expansion.
Priya Rao: Node log excerpt: `2026-03-20T14:02:11Z node-12 runtime=3.2 kernel=tiling quant=on OOM alloc_kv_cache 19.3GB`
deploy-bot: /pin runtime=3.1 scope=model-group:quant-v2 region=eu duration=48h reason="canary-mem-growth" requested_by=Priya Rao
deploy-bot: Pin request received: pin-9002 queued
oncall-sre: Ops note  Scheduled unpins in EU for next 48h are paused until further notice.
Diego Martinez: My read: lower-risk to pinback to 3.1 for quant-v2 in EU and run root-cause offline. We avoid global rollback.
Lena Kim: Agreed. Also want an experiment disabling kv prefetcher in 3.2 to confirm. Will run 3.2-prefetch-off in us-canary.
Priya Rao: I'll patch the internal release notes. Short blurb: "Soft pin: runtime-3.1 enforced for quant-v2 in EU (48h) due to memory increase observed on runtime-3.2 in long sequences. Investigation ongoing."
Priya Rao: creating ticket RH-TICKET-3500 and linking dashboards.
Diego Martinez: Deploy step: who runs the pin?
Priya Rao: deploy-bot already queued it, ops-sre will apply.
ops-sre: Pin applied: id=pin-9002 runtime=3.1 model-group=quant-v2 region=eu expires=2026-03-22T14:05Z applied_by=ops-sre
Lena Kim: Experiment started in us-canary with pref-off build. I'll post results in ~30m.
Diego Martinez: Add routing fallback to dedicated for quant-v2 if mem > 16GB or latency > 2s  for 5 minutes.
oncall-sre: Fallback rule added to routing: threshold mem>16GB OR p95_latency>2000ms sustained 5m -> route to dedicated.
Priya Rao: SDK note: internal SDKs using explicit runtime pinning should be aware: users in EU requesting quant-v2 may get runtime 3.1 until pin expires. I'll add to changelog.
Lena Kim: pref-off results: memory profile stable, no kv growth in pref-off job. flamegraph: https://redwood.trace/fg-9987
Diego Martinez: That suggests interaction with prefetcher + tiling. Next actions: 1) escalate to runtime team for a prefetcher patch 2) keep pin for 48h 3) decide on kernel rollback if patch low-confidence.
Priya Rao: I'll update RH-TICKET-3500 with experiment logs and set priority P2->P1 if we see any customer impact.
oncall-sre: Monitoring: added incident annotation and on-call is watching EU canaries and production errors.
deploy-bot: pin-9002 recorded to live pinlist at 2026-03-20T14:06Z
Diego Martinez: If prefatch-off confirms, propose a targeted runtime patch (3.2.1) that disables prefetcher by default for quant paths and re-enable after fix. Plan in ticket.
Priya Rao: Thank you everyone. We'll reconvene if metrics worsen or tomorrow for post-mortem.
